name: Category Tile with Caption
description: Category Tile displayed with an image and text.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Popular Category
attribute_definition_groups.description: Specify the category to be displayed.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom display name
attribute_definitions.description: Overwrite the category name if needed.

attribute_definitions.name: Display name class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the display name for styling purposes, e.g. 'h2 text--black mb-2'. Add 'custom' to remove other styles directly applied to this element.

attribute_definitions.name: Secondary text
attribute_definitions.description: Optional dditional text placed below the display name.

attribute_definitions.name: Secondary text class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the secondary text for styling purposes, e.g. 'text--gray'. Add 'custom' to remove other styles directly applied to this element.

attribute_definitions.name: Text alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Only applicable if Text Placement is set to 'below image'.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom image
attribute_definitions.description: If used, this will replace the default category image. For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Image Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: Add alternative text for image, default is an empty string. See following to better understand what to write: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/images.html#alt

attribute_definitions.name: Background Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to set a background color for the component if there is no image selected. e.g. 'background--brand-secondary' See the Style Guide for more color options.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Video URL
attribute_definitions.description: Add a URL for a video to play as the background image. YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted MP4s are supported.

attribute_definitions.name: image size
attribute_definitions.description: Style used in this field if the image needs to be sized up or down. example '80%', 'cover', or 'contain'. Default is 'cover', which will scale the image up to fill the container.

attribute_definitions.name: offset
attribute_definitions.description: How the image should be offset. example '0 10px'. If a custom image is set, use the focus point instead.

attribute_definitions.name: Aspect ratio
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a shape for the Category Tile. Default is square.
